title: DataManifestSchema
description: Validation schema for HackInsight raw data manifest (manifest.csv / manifest.json)

source_name.description: Formal human-readable name of the dataset

source_url.description: URL or query description where source was obtained

fetch_timestamp_utc.description: Exact UTC timestamp when the data was acquired

raw_file_path.description: Relative path to the immutable raw file inside the workspace

file_format.description: MIME type or common format descriptor (e.g., text/icartt, application/json, text/csv)

license.description: Explicit license identifier or terms reference

row_count.description: Total raw observation rows if applicable

query_parameters.description: Non-secret query parameters (e.g. coordinates, dates, parameters)
